Good, I can see the SailPoint tools. Let me search for source and aggregation operations.
Now let me pull the full details on each of those three operations plus the auth guide in parallel.

Here's the full walkthrough, step by step.

---

## Step 0 — Authenticate

All ISC API calls use an OAuth2 client credentials grant backed by a Personal Access Token (PAT).

**Exchange your PAT for a bearer token:**

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={your_client_id}
&client_secret={your_client_secret}
```

> Send credentials in the **body**, never as query params. The token expires; re-request as needed. Rate limit is 100 requests/token/10 s — watch for `429` + `Retry-After`.

Save the returned `access_token` — every call below needs:
```
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

---

## Step 1 — Create the Source

`POST /v3/sources`

Required scope: `idn:sources:manage`

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "My LDAP Source",
  "description": "Corporate LDAP directory",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "{owner_identity_id}",
    "name": "John Smith"
  },
  "connector": "active-directory",
  "connectorName": "Active Directory",
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "host": "ldap.example.com",
    "port": 389,
    "baseDN": "DC=example,DC=com"
  },
  "authoritative": false,
  "deleteThreshold": 10
}
```

> **`connector`** is the connector type key (e.g. `active-directory`, `jdbc`, `scim2`). **`connectorAttributes`** is connector-specific. **`owner.id`** must be an existing identity's ID in ISC.
>
> For a **CSV/Delimited File** source, add `?provisionAsCsv=true` to the query string instead of setting `type` directly.

**Response** (201) — save the `id` from the response body:
```json
{
  "id": "2c9180857f8c4a3e017f9d88e4960023",
  "name": "My LDAP Source",
  ...
}
```

---

## Step 2 — Kick Off Account Aggregation

`POST /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts`

Required scope: `idn:sources:manage`  
Required header: `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true` (beta endpoint gate)

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/sources/2c9180857f8c4a3e017f9d88e4960023/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "disableOptimization": false
}
```

> - **`disableOptimization`** — set to `true` to force a full aggregation (ignores delta detection). Omit or set `false` for a normal optimized run.
> - For CSV sources, you'd instead supply a **`file`** field (multipart/form-data) with the CSV content.

**Response** (202) — returns the aggregation task ID:
```json
{
  "id": "2c9180867f1b0a6e017f1b3a4ce1004b",
  "type": "ACCOUNT_AGGREGATION",
  "status": "PENDING",
  ...
}
```

Save that `id` to poll status.

---

## Step 3 — Poll Aggregation Status

`GET /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status`

Required header: `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/account-aggregations/2c9180867f1b0a6e017f1b3a4ce1004b/status
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "2c9180867f1b0a6e017f1b3a4ce1004b",
  "status": "IN_PROGRESS",
  "totalAccounts": 1500,
  "processedAccounts": 423,
  "newAccounts": 12,
  "changedAccounts": 5,
  "deletedAccounts": 0
}
```

Poll until `status` is no longer `IN_PROGRESS`. This endpoint only returns data for **in-flight** aggregations — once complete it will 404, meaning the job finished.

---

## Summary of the Call Sequence

| # | Method | Path | Note |
|---|--------|------|------|
| 0 | POST | `/oauth/token` | Get bearer token |
| 1 | POST | `/v3/sources` | Create the source |
| 2 | POST | `/beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts` | Trigger aggregation |
| 3 | GET  | `/beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status` | Poll until done |

---
